title: Three Weeks and One Short Tag
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：item　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 item 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the vendor ① priced the item that no neighbour in the stall would have recorded, and he said the pricing was the whole of the day. The ② item, meaning the thing itself and not the tag, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; an item, he said, is the only thing in a stall that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ item in that stall had the same short tag beside it, and the ④ item at the far basket, meaning the note they kept for the children to read and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An item, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the vendor said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the item was the whole of the matter, meaning the price and not the thing. The ⑥ item, meaning the price and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; item, he said, is either something you price or the only word that means both a thing and a price. He said the price is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ item had become a line in a receipt, and the receipt had become an argument about the short tag. The ⑧ item of the whole thing, the vendor wrote in May, was one stall and three days of recording; item, he said, is either the note at the far basket or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ item I remember is the thing recorded in the receipt, which closed in 1996 and is still recorded as the quietest in the stall. An ⑩ item, my mother said in 1998, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; every item, she said, is a price that has agreed to look like a thing. She said the price was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。

F. n. 一件商品；条目（指收据里写到、被记下的的那一件）
G. n. 价钱、价值（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: price the item 意为“标这件商品的价”，1989 年那位摊主把摊位里没有一位邻居肯记录的一件商品做了一遍。
item 意为“一件商品；条目”，指那件货品本身而不是价签，它经过了三个天而在簿子上没有被记录。
item 意为“一件商品；条目”，指摊位里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一枚小小的价签。
item 意为“一件商品；条目”，指最远那只篮子留给孩子们读的那一枚那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
item 意为“价钱、价值”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个价钱就是那件事的全部。
item 意为“价值”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件货品，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
item 意为“一件商品；条目”，指收据里写到、被记下的的那一件，到 1994 年这一件成了收据里的一行。
item 意为“买卖之事”，摊主五月写道，整件事的商品之事是一处摊位和三个天的记录。
item 意为“一件商品；条目”，我记得的是收据里记录过的那一件，1996 年售出了，至今仍被说成摊位里最安静的一件。
item 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，商品是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的货品。
